name: Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in producing cathode materials crucial for lithium-ion batteries. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes power ternary compounds, lithium cobalt oxide, composite ternary formulations, cobalt-nickel lithium manganese ternary compounds, and high manganese polycrystalline products. These essential materials are widely applied in the consumer electronics and automotive industries. The company, which was founded in 2004 and is based in Shenzhen, China, operated under the name Shenzhen Zhenhua New Material Co., LTD until it officially rebranded to Guizhou Zhenhua New Material Co., Ltd. in May 2018.
